review: W7 parent integration: independent named-part route and queue review
review_method: Actual source-extracted offlineAsk, offlineCanHandle, offlineEditAsk, offlineMaterialPlan, queueEditZones, editKey and related helpers; actual SpbProEdit.plan/compile and SpbProDesign.compoundPlan. Native/canvas application effects and helper-owned existing-zone state were stubbed. No browser, native app, provider, MCP, or external AI calls.

contract.frozen_case_coverage: 16 independent frozen routes; five exactPart command routes and one scoped source-colour correction; direct real compile and queue projection; offlineCanHandle eligibility checked with configured-state flag false and true.
verified: Color-only roof/hood edits reused helper-owned named-part zones without sending a finish replacement; finish-only and relative-finish edits omitted color and retained the existing color.
The roof hue correction compiled to color='source' and hue=131, and the actual queued edit now carries both fields while retaining the existing finish.
A compound roof recolor plus flame-graphics request no longer queues a partial roof edit; the real offlineEditAsk coverage guard leaves it unchanged for clarification.
Protected hood requests ask before mutation; explicit two-part and whole-body-plus-part cases do not claim exactPart or widen to an unrelated area.
The trailing-courtesy request 'Paint the hood red, please.' parses and routes as an exact named-part edit.
Post-oracle prohibitions 'Do not make the roof red.', 'Do not paint the hood red.', and 'Never repaint the passenger side gold.' all remain nonmutating in the real route harness.

previous_finding_and_resolution.previous_finding: R14 'Change the blue on the roof to red.' compiled color='source' and hue=131, but queueEditZones dropped both transform fields.
previous_finding_and_resolution.current_resolution: On current source, queueEditZones copies hue/saturation/brightness and relevant explicit overlay/control fields into the edit args, and forwards color='source' when a hue/shade transform is present. The frozen route test now passes on the current source hash.

limits: This verifies source routing, compilation and queued callback fields, not native/canvas persistence or actual live paint pixels. Parent owns native acceptance.
SpbMaterialControls was intentionally absent for this W7 route review; dedicated material-control behavior is outside this lane.
The frozen oracle remained unchanged. Three prohibition probes and four hue/shade projection supplements were added after source inspection and are reported separately from the frozen cases.
